occupations.title: Customer Service Representatives
occupations.mapping: model-inferred from pack D (no review data)
occupations.rationale: The product is a help desk software used for managing "Client Experience" [D:Zoho Desk:landing:3] by routing tickets, collaborating on issues, and tracking service level agreements [D:Zoho Desk:landing:2, D:Zoho Desk:landing:3].

tasks.text: Confer with customers by telephone or in person to provide information about products or services, take or enter orders, cancel accounts, or obtain details of complaints.
Keep records of customer interactions or transactions, recording details of inquiries, complaints, or comments, as well as actions taken.
Complete contract forms, prepare change of address records, or issue service discontinuance orders, using computers.
Check to ensure that appropriate changes were made to resolve customers' problems.

occupations.title: Computer User Support Specialists
occupations.mapping: model-inferred from pack D (no review data)
occupations.rationale: These specialists provide help desk support and would use the software to handle routine issues, route tickets to the right person, and collaborate across teams for resolution [D:Zoho Desk:landing:1, D:Zoho Desk:landing:2].

tasks.text: Answer user inquiries regarding computer software or hardware operation to resolve problems.
Set up equipment for employee use, performing or ensuring proper installation of cables, operating systems, or appropriate software.
Maintain records of daily data communication transactions, problems and remedial actions taken, or installation activities.
Refer major hardware or software problems or defective products to vendors or technicians for service.

occupations.title: Computer and Information Systems Managers
occupations.mapping: model-inferred from pack D (no review data)
occupations.rationale: Managers of support teams would use the software to assign and route tickets based on agent skills and workload, and to set and monitor service level agreements with automated escalations [D:Zoho Desk:landing:2, D:Zoho Desk:landing:3].

tasks.text: Assign and review the work of systems analysts, programmers, and other computer-related workers.
Review project plans to plan and coordinate project activity.
Provide users with technical support for computer problems.
Consult with users, management, vendors, and technicians to assess computing needs and system requirements.
